name: Glass newsletter signup
oneLiner: a newsletter signup card pops in tilted on glass (the latest issue cover, the brand mark, name and reader count), an address types into the field, a cursor presses the button, it turns into a green Subscribed check with a burst and the reader count ticks up by one
say: when the speaker plugs the newsletter or the free resource ('it is all in my free letter', 'link below to get it'): the press lands on 'subscribe' or 'free', the count ticks as they say who else reads it
